info.title: Verification Service API
info.summary: Alpha API contract for Emmy verification workflows supporting community engagement reporting.
info.description: Public alpha API contract for the Eligibility Made Easy (Emmy) verification service. Emmy is a CMS-developed suite of open-source tools that supports community engagement reporting through data sharing and verification across multiple data sources. This API allows state-managed applications to submit standardized identity payloads and request verification results such as education enrollment and VA disability rating data. Client applications must authenticate with an OAuth 2.0 bearer token obtained through the client credentials flow. This API is not stable and should be treated as highly volatile for the next several months. Breaking changes are likely as the alpha release evolves.
